# MiniAudioPreview

A 32px inline player for a track's preview clip: one play/pause button, a thin progress line and the time in mono, with only one preview playing anywhere in the app.

`SongNodes.MiniAudioPreview` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.MiniAudioPreview title="…" src="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.MiniAudioPreview" title="…" src="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (MiniAudioPreviewProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string \| null` | Preview clip URL (about 30 seconds); missing or failing renders the unavailable state. |
| `title` * | `string` | Track named in the button label ("Bicep – Glue"). |
| `duration` | `number` | Clip length in seconds when known before loading (default 30). |
